game.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
game.blurb: Third-person action shooter set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, from Saber Interactive, released 2024-09-09. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: Captain Titus and his squad fighting through the story missions, with their hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Operations
chapters.summary: The Operations missions: the Ruthless threat level, pickups and kill goals against Tyranids and Chaos servants.

chapters.title: Eternal War

chapters.title: Combat Feats

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first search result was the wrong entry ("warhammer-40000-space-marine-2", id 988673, no release date, PC only), so the detail for the expected slug "warhammer-40000-space-marine-ii" (id 705616, released 2024-09-09, PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X) was fetched and used instead. StrategyWiki has a stub page under "Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2" (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); only a short Table of Contents (about 480 characters) exists, and the Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls, Enemies and Achievements and trophies subpages it links are not written, so nothing was used. warhammer40k.fandom.com has no page under "Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2"; "Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II" redirects to "Space Marine II", with about 157 linked pages (mostly lore, such as "Demetrian Titus", "Graia", "Kadaku", "Avarax", "Tyranids" and "Thousand Sons"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 2183900. 16 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden and have no descriptions; they sit in the campaign chapter. "Outbound Payload" (deliver a nova cannon warhead to the Tyranid position) does not say which mode it belongs to; it is placed in the campaign as a guess. "Defender of Humanity" (overcome every challenge, 0.9%) sits with the combat feats. Operations and Eternal War achievements need online or co-op play.
